sentences.en: They could hear the sounds of shots and exploding shells.
sentences.zh: 他们能听到枪声和炮弹爆炸的声音。

sentences.en: The flag had holes in it from the British shells.
sentences.zh: 那面旗帜被英国的炮弹打出了孔洞。

sentences.en: Agriculture became possible inside the shell structure of space stations.
sentences.zh: 在太空站壳体结构内，农业变得可能了。
